evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3503878 ($99.92, product R, online) scores 0.72 on the calibrated transaction model trained only on the bank's closed cases (out-of-time AUC 0.964 vs 0.866 for the bank's risk score). The bank's own risk score was 0.90.
Card baseline from 219 earlier transactions: median $116.92, 95th percentile $556.84; the flagged amount is 0.9x the median.
Device profile 'Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720' was not used by this card before; identity record marks it New.
Simulated customer validation: Cardholder states they did not make this transaction and still has the card.
Card-not-present fraud from a new device: as above, with the identity record marking the device New for this account, sometimes behind a proxy.
Policy R2: Customer denies the transaction: BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE; FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.
